title: Handoff tool and turn.handoff event
description:
As a member, I want a bot to connect me to another session, so that I reach the right bot without bots messaging each other.

Feature: Handoff
  Scenario: A bot connects the user to another session
    Given a session at /ops/deploy exists
    When the bot calls connect_user with /ops/deploy
    Then the turn stream carries turn.handoff with that path
    And a reconnect or reload still finds the handoff

See docs/SESSION_NAMESPACE.md.
right_now_summary: The handoff tool and event are being defined to connect users to another session and preserve that link.
